test_overview: Regression smoke test of the ComfortPro Connect HVAC/Plumbing platform executed via Playwright using two browser contexts (context_A = Client Olivia Chen, context_B = Technician Noah Patel), covering the full MVP flow (Client booking → Technician job conversion → invoice) plus read-only access rules. All 5 steps passed fully. Step 1: Client signed up and created Booking #1 (HVAC/Repair/Standard, 10 W Hubbard St, Chicago, IL 60654, Sep 7 2026 AM, 'AC not cooling.'), shown as 'New' and entirely read-only. Step 2: Technician signed up; dashboard provided Bookings/Jobs/Invoices (+ extension items RFPs/Vendors/POs); converted Booking #1 to Job #1 (Scheduled Sep 7 2026 AM); job started 'Scheduled' with Noah Patel as assigned technician; converted booking removed from Bookings list. Step 3: Strict status flows verified - direct skip to Completed blocked while Scheduled; Scheduled → In Progress ok; completion without note rejected ('At least one note is required'); after adding note 'Replaced capacitor; unit cooling restored.' the job reached Completed. Step 4: Technician created Draft invoice ($250.00, due Sep 22 2026), visible to Technician but not to Client; after Send + Confirm it became 'Sent' and appeared for the Client as read-only ($250.00). Step 5: Client job view is read-only with no status/notes/photos controls and displays Completed status plus technician name, schedule, address, and note. No app code was modified. Total score 14/14.

steps.description: test_client_signup_and_booking - PASS. Client Olivia Chen signed up (nav had Properties, Bookings, Jobs, Invoices + extra '+ New Service Request', allowed). Created Booking #1 with all specified details; confirmation showed Booking ID #1. Re-opened from Bookings list: status 'New' (not yet converted to Job). Booking detail fully read-only as plain text with only a Back button (no edit controls); name/email prefilled + readonly. Description unchanged.

test_technician_converts_booking_to_job - PASS. Technician Noah Patel signed up; nav had Bookings/Jobs/Invoices + extension items RFPs/Vendors/POs (allowed); no Properties link so Technician cannot manage Properties. Booking #1 visible as 'New'; Convert to Job set Scheduled Sep 7 2026 AM; Job #1 created in 'Scheduled' status with assigned technician Noah Patel; converted booking no longer appears in Bookings list ('No active bookings.').

test_job_status_progression - PASS. Confirmed initial 'Scheduled'. Direct skip to Completed blocked (only 'In Progress' selectable while Scheduled). Scheduled → In Progress succeeded. Completion without a note rejected with 'At least one note is required before completing the job'. After adding note 'Replaced capacitor; unit cooling restored.', Completed succeeded.

test_invoice_visibility_rules - PASS. From Completed Job #1, Technician created Draft invoice ($250.00, due 2026-09-22) - visible to Technician; Client's 'My Invoices' and Job#1 Invoices both showed 'No invoices yet.' so Draft not visible to Client. After 'Send to Client' + Confirm, status became 'Sent' and appeared to Client as read-only ($250.00). Step passed.

test_client_job_read_only - PASS. Client opened Job #1: visible with Status Completed. Detail showed technician Noah Patel, schedule Sep 7 2026 AM, location 10 W Hubbard St, Chicago, IL 60654, and the technician note. No status-change, add-note, or upload-photo controls present for the client (count=0 across page), so client cannot change status or add notes/photos.
